description: This file defines a Moose role for a Catalyst plugin that sets the HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) header in web responses. It hooks into the 'prepare_action' phase to conditionally add the header based on configuration and request scheme.

classes.name: Coocook::Plugin::StrictTransportSecurity
classes.description: A Moose role implementing a Catalyst plugin to add the HTTP Strict Transport Security header to responses, based on configuration and request scheme.

methods.name: after prepare_action
methods.description: A Moose method modifier that executes after the 'prepare_action' method, setting the HSTS header if conditions are met.
